items.label: IfcPipeSegment 'PL-301 compressed air DN25 segment 2' x 2 elements: 'CV-301 side rail south', 'CV-301 side rail north'
items.understanding: DN25 air pipe runs north and crosses both south and north side rails of CV-301 with 50 mm overlap. Gravity is not an issue and the pipe is small, so the pipe must drop locally under each rail. No single down position is clear across both rails at once, so each crossing needs its own dip with return to line between.

option.title: Side-step pipe 900 mm west past both rail ends
option.rationale: Single west step uses the +0.85 to +1.00 m side room that is clear past both rails at once.

alternatives.title: Dip pipe down 150 mm under each rail
alternatives.rationale: Minimal down move stays within the -0.65 to -0.13 m clear room at each rail and returns to line between rails where a continuous dip is not clear.
alternatives.also_needs: 8 bends and short vertical risers, none

edit.summary: reroute 150 mm down at 1.75-2.25 m, then 150 mm down at 2.45-2.95 m
